article.title: Contravention of order made during search action.
article.content:
Whoever contravenes any order referred to in the second proviso to sub-section (1) or sub-section (3) of section 132 shall be punishable with
24[simple imprisonment for a term up to two years and with fine].
article.html:
275A23[Contravention of order made during search action.]

Section 275A · Chapter XXII · page 1003 of the Act

Whoever contravenes any order referred to in the second proviso to sub-section (1) or sub-section (3) of section 132 shall be punishable with

24[simple imprisonment for a term up to two years and with fine].

23 Sub. for "Contravention of order made under sub-section (3) of section 132." by Act No. 4 of 2026, w.e.f. 1-3-2026.

24 Sub. for "rigorous imprisonment which may extend to two years and shall also be liable to fine" by Act No. 4 of 2026, w.e.f. 1-3-2026.
